title: The flow of stages audited end to end: the timeline as it plays and the problems ranked (docs/FLOW.md)
context: Owner, 2026-11-12: "the gameplay and pacing needs a lot of work"; "we have many good elements to use, now they must all fit together into a coherent whole"; "we will tune the difficulty later, first we want the flow of stages." Much merged on 2026-11-12 (the dog opening paced up, no start bank and 10x prices, the hunted rover, the King's fight, the rover's routing) and nobody had played the whole arc since. A measure-and-report job on main e4e9cefb: no game change.
outcome: docs/FLOW.md: one table of 22 stages from the landing to the campaign card (trigger, measured length, the player's verb, what tells him, the hand-over, status) and eleven problems ranked. The worst: (1) a seat hides Isao's panel (app.css .sentry-pilot-mode #td-brief) while the queue still spends the lines, so wave_cleared, first_harvest and the owner's three economy lines (no_bank, biomass_bonds, biomass_seeps, captions only) are never seen on the opening; (2) SECURE is not the end of a sector: sector 6's debrief waited the 120 s calm cap while the gate was pushed in, sector 7 was LOST 102 s after it read SECURE (the bodies not yet identified); (3) the first harvest is 48 s in the Rotor's optic with no target; (4) sector 0 has 72 s with no instruction after TANK IS READY; (5) the expedition hands to sector 1 on a 90 s clock; (6) print close-ups and the FEIDS drop cut into live fights. Stale words: THE KING card's hint teaches paint-then-release; sentry_overload_01 says ten sentries. Missing from the design's 19: domes by kind and cell, the radar as a choice, the Queen as a fight, the walk, a new planet. New probe --flow (scripts/browser-test.mjs).
alternatives: Reading the code and the director board alone: rejected, the hidden panel and the SECURE-then-LOST showed only in play.
A player-paced probe (driving the hull to the sites, firing SOL): not built; the lengths are the ideal defender's floor, said so on the page.
evidence: scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --flow (FROM=open TO=3): no page error; story beats landed > dog-print > walled > printing > rotor-ready > tremor > piloting (33.6 s game) > harvest (59.2) > orders card (108.0) > quiver-piloting (108.3) > construction, gunship seat (126.4) > hull early (133.4) > hull out (205.1) > settled (225.4) > study-talk (246.0) > study screen (253.2) > expedition (253.5) > C-07 print (273.5-288.8) > sector 1 (352.0) > SECURE (467.3) > debrief and board (470.1) > sector 2 (470.3) > antennaPrint mid-fight (487.7-499.6) > SECURE (623.2) > board > sector 3 (639.6).
